products.title: Distinctive Ethiopian Coffee Lots
products.intro: Prepared for roasters, importers, and specialty coffee partners worldwide.

washed.name: Washed
washed.desc: Clean washed lots prepared for roasters who need clarity and consistent cup structure.
washed.details: Washed coffee is selected for clean acidity, clear floral notes, and reliable structure. It is ideal for buyers who want a bright Ethiopian cup that performs well in filter roasting.

natural.name: Natural
natural.desc: Sun-dried naturals with a round body, berry sweetness, and a classic Yirgacheffe profile.
natural.details: Natural coffee is dried carefully to build sweetness and fruit character. This lot style works well for roasters looking for a memorable cup with body and aroma.

honey.name: Honey
honey.desc: Carefully processed honey coffee with fruit-forward sweetness and a polished finish.
honey.details: Honey processing keeps selected mucilage during drying, creating a cup that balances fruit, sweetness, and a rounded mouthfeel.

anaerobic.name: Anaerobic
anaerobic.desc: Carefully fermented anaerobic coffee with expressive fruit, layered sweetness, and a vibrant finish.
anaerobic.details: Anaerobic coffee is fermented in sealed, oxygen-limited tanks to develop intense fruit character, layered sweetness, and a distinctive aromatic cup.

experimental.name: Experimental
experimental.desc: A limited experimental coffee prepared for interested buyers.
experimental.details: This information is only provided for buyers!

about.journeyTitle: Rooted at origin, committed to quality.
about.step1Desc: Our local knowledge begins in Ethiopia's renowned coffee-growing communities, where altitude, soil, and careful cultivation shape every lot.

about.step3Desc: Washed and natural coffees are prepared with close attention to sorting, drying, consistency, and each coffee's character.
about.step4Desc: Quality control continues through preparation, packaging, and shipment so every coffee arrives ready for the global market.

about.value2Desc: Friendly, professional service shaped around each client's needs.

about.value4Desc: Supporting Ethiopia, its people, and its coffee communities.
